decision: Stage 1-6 passes as an asset-reference census. All 94 occurrence rows are accounted for at the reference layer: 37 Banner and 57 Picture_Notice rows; 73 matched and 21 manual-replacement statuses; 93 concrete filenames and one null manual-wish reference; 81 static and 13 prefab visual-source cases. Manual replacement is not equivalent to a missing image because 20 of 21 such rows already reference a concrete replacement file. Verified source reuses can carry the same display asset reference across dates, but filename equality is supporting display evidence only and must not become a canonical source/recurrence join. Hashing, visual duplicate detection, candidate matching, asset ownership, and bulk asset inventory remain deferred to Stage 3.
